evidence.title: fix(goal): keep a full-claim checkpoint replay from spending a stall, and tidy batching follow-ups by qqqys · Pull Request #11796 · QwenLM/qwen-code · GitHub

name: fix(goal): keep a full-claim checkpoint replay from spending a stall
summary: Merged pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code: a successful checkpoint replay no longer spends a stall, plus small Goal batching and docs fixes.
description: Merged pull request (#11796) in QwenLM/qwen-code: follow-ups to the Goal checkpoint batching work — a checkpoint replay that succeeds full no longer spends a stall, which could stop a session restored one stall short of GOAL_CHECKPOINT_STALL_LIMIT as usage_limited before its first turn; the docs now explain goalCheckpointTimeoutSeconds and batched active-time accounting, and the restore-replay tests share one crash-state harness.
